title: Zero-TVM: Phi-3-mini in the browser on hand-written WGSL kernels
description: A browser-native Phi-3-mini inference engine built on 10 hand-written WGSL kernel roles (27 files) and ~2,000 lines of TypeScript, replacing WebLLM / MLC-LLM's TVM-compiled 85-kernel stack while reaching ~80% of its decode speed on identical quantized weights.
notes: Live demo: https://zerotvm.com — Source and methodology: https://github.com/abgnydn/zero-tvm
